platform.timing: per query min over 5 interleaved repetitions after 5 warm-up queries; single-thread Python, numpy default BLAS threads

query_accounting.rule: per pool, eligible = records whose (scan_id, target_id) has >=2 expressions inside that pool; eligible records are ordered by sha256(seed:query:record_key) and the first min(500, eligible) are evaluated (base._query_indices).
query_accounting.tuning_rule: per pool, the eligible records after the first 500 in the same hash order, excluding any record that is an evaluation query in any pool, first 500 kept

selection_rules.accuracy: max tuning hit@3, ties by hit@1 then fewer mean leaf records
selection_rules.budget: fewest mean leaf records among configs with tuning hit@3 >= flat tuning hit@3
selection_rules.gate_only: accuracy rule restricted to m=0 (no safety shortlist); added after tuning-only inspection
selection_rules.budget_1pp: fewest mean leaf records with tuning hit@3 >= flat tuning hit@3 - 0.01; added after tuning-only inspection

protocol.quality_source: hit@1/hit@3 for every method (flat included) come from one canonical exact score vector per query (pool sorted_matrix @ q) with deterministic tie-breaking (score desc, position asc), so flat and hierarchy break near-ties identically
protocol.timed_path: latency and scored-record counts come from separate end-to-end executions; timed_path_hit_* re-derive quality from those executions (flat uses the unchanged base._top_indices); disagreements are counted in timed_vs_grid_mismatches
protocol.query_exclusion: query record excluded from leaves; summary variant removes the query vector from its own branch mean (leave-one-out); HNSW results drop the query key
protocol.record_count_convention: leaf_records counts all records of selected branches (query included, as in scene_scoped_dense_exact) plus shortlist records outside them
